title: [sweep] v18.5.0 release test sweep
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task.** On 2026-11-15 the maintainer asked triage to have the qa seat run a pre-release test: 「你信箱让qa席位做一个发版本前的测试」. Business reason: 18.5.0 ships through Version Packages PR #33097, with about 320 commits since `@objectstack/cli@18.4.0`, 59 of them marked breaking (`!`). Customer projects (HotCRM O2C and PSA, the downstream carbon-black CRM) wait on this release. These runs are its evidence. ⛔ Not a claim.

Reader: the qa seat runs it (`checklist-test`). Checklist-accuracy lines go to `domain:devx` (the `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` owner), as in the 18.4.0 sweep #32908. Dedupe: searched `[sweep] v18.5.0`; no anchor exists. The previous one is #32908 (18.4.0, closed).

This card is the **wave anchor**. RUNNER's extraction obligation applies: checklist-accuracy findings, fixture gaps, `partial` coverage and not-run hand-overs close out **here**; product defects become their own cards, listed in §2; run records are `qa-run` issues that reference this card.

## Plan

**Round 1** on current `main` @ `a557fa386bc3` (or the newest fully green commit when the run starts), with the Console built in-tree from the same commit:

| record | selector | why |
|---|---|---|
| R-P0 | `priority:P0` | the standing smoke |
| R-185 | items touched by the 18.4.0..main diff (`touched:` selector) | the change set of this release |
| R-CUST | the customer-waited fixes below, as named items, plus an off-clause probe of each | what the waiting customers will run first |

R-CUST, by card:
- #33250: controlled_by_parent `writeRequiresMasterRead` (HotCRM O2C: a reader of the master inserts and updates detail rows).
- #33238: `renamedFrom` position holders carried on a hot install or upgrade.
- #33214 / PR #33641 and #33213: localized hook refusals and duplicate refusals.
- #33206 / #33207: org-scoped seed (owner references, an organization in the seed execution context). This is BREAKING in walled mode; check that the upgrade note matches behaviour.
- #33181 / PR #33227: pending SSO-only users, add and CSV import (managed environment).
- #33512: one-hop cross-object analytics `where`, and its 1000-parent refusal.

**Round 2** on the frozen release sha (the Version Packages merge) once it exists: every round-1 FAIL, plus items touched by fixes that land between the rounds.

## Release read

§0 at round close: PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL per record. Any p0-class failure blocks the cut. A FAIL from a customer item goes to the maintainer at once.

## Owed elsewhere (not this card)

The 18.5.0 curated release notes (`content/docs/releases/v18`, the 需手动处理 section for the breaking changes), and refreshing the Version Packages PR before the merge.
